kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Specify the kind of Button you want to create

size.name: Size
size.description: Specify the size of the button

disabled.name: Disabled
disabled.description: Specify whether the Button should be disabled, or not

hasIconOnly.name: Has Icon Only
hasIconOnly.description: Specify if the button is an icon-only button

isExpressive.name: Is Expressive
isExpressive.description: Specify whether the Button is expressive, or not

isSelected.name: Is Selected
isSelected.description: Specify whether the Button is currently selected. Only applies to the icon only Ghost variant.

iconDescription.name: Icon Description
iconDescription.description: Description for the icon that can be read by screen readers

renderIcon.name: Icon
renderIcon.description: A component used to render an icon.

tooltipAlignment.name: Tooltip Alignment
tooltipAlignment.description: Alignment of the tooltip for icon-only buttons.

tooltipPosition.name: Tooltip Position
tooltipPosition.description: Direction of the tooltip for icon-only buttons.

tooltipDropShadow.name: Tooltip Drop Shadow
tooltipDropShadow.description: Enable drop shadow for tooltips for icon-only buttons.

tooltipHighContrast.name: Tooltip High Contrast
tooltipHighContrast.description: Enable high-contrast theme for tooltips for icon-only buttons.

type.name: Type
type.description: Optional prop to specify the type of the Button
